title: The golden's Net Income deducts the non-cash tax step-up amortization (about 258/yr), and the FCF section never adds it back. That turns FCF deeply negative every year and distorts every downstream debt, cash and returns cell, so an agent applying standard LBO logic will fail.
evidence: Golden LBO G69 =SUM(G66:G68) with G66 =G64+G75 (G75 = -N24 = -258.46). G69 = -216.76, G99 = -293.45, revolver N135 = 1710.57, IRR N204 = 7.1%. Rows 94-98 contain no add-back of G75.
